text: App developers never run Terraform to ship a feature. They update app repos; CI builds an image; a gitops manifest change is reconciled by Argo CD onto infrastructure that already exists.

text.font-family: Inter, Liberation Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text: Terraform is invoked (plan/apply) and then exits; its desired state remains in infra-terraform + the remote state backend. Argo CD is the opposite: a long-running reconciler.

text.font-family: Inter, Liberation Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text: If node capacity, a new cluster, or a database must be created, that is this flow — not a CI “deploy” job. Caption: Terraform creates the infrastructure. Argo CD deploys workloads onto it.
